name: lmt-go-ui
description: Colombo bus trip planner and live map for Lanka Metro Transit, with an Effect v4 transit API

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && tsx watch --env-file-if-exists=.env src/server.ts
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/core packages/upstream packages/fleet packages/publisher packages/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/node --noEmit
